name: AI Deep Reference
description: Registers Drupal tokens that expose the raw description text of taxonomy terms referenced from a node, for building AI prompts.
project_description:
If you want to use AI to illustrate a scene, you can connect all the necessary parts using the AI module , plus the Token module. There's just one missing piece: the tokens are "shallow," and you can't get details from taxonomy terms.

 The solution: this module!

 Features 
 Adds an extra token: node:field_term:description 

 Additional Requirements 
 Although this module is meant to be used with the AI ecosystem, that's not strictly required. The only thing you actually need is the Token module.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 AI module, plus the AI Automator, are recommended for maximum benefit.

 Further Reading 
 Check out the blog post .
